t: Gardener: Run Compass report + Lathe rescore as nightly post-tend steps
description: After all spokes are tended, the gardener should: (1) re-run lathe_score.py to update spoke scores based on tonight's results, (2) run compass_report.py to generate tomorrow's morning dashboard, (3) write the results to gardener pass record. This ensures the user wakes up to a fresh dashboard every morning. Modify wheel-tender.sh or run_nightly.py to add post-tend steps.
perceive: Read the end of wheel-tender.sh to find where post-tend logic goes. Read run_nightly.py for the nightly orchestration flow.
execute: Add post-tend block after all spokes are tended: (1) python3 tools/lathe_score.py (rescore with fresh data), (2) python3 tools/compass_report.py (generate dashboard), (3) log both steps to gardener pass record. Add error handling — if either script fails, log but don't block the commit.
verify: Run wheel-tender.sh --all in test mode. After tending, verify lathe_score.py ran and spoke_lathe.json updated. Verify compass_report.py ran and new dashboard generated. Verify gardener pass record includes post-tend steps.
acceptance_criteria: Lathe rescore runs after every nightly tend
Post-tend step failures logged but don't block gardener
Gardener pass record shows post-tend execution
